name: chezmoi
description: Installs chezmoi and optionally writes a configuration file.

install.description: If true, installs the chezmoi binary.

config.description: Configuration content to write to ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.{configFormat}. When non-empty, the file is created so it can be merged with settings defined in your dotfiles repository.

configFormat.description: Format of the configuration file written when 'config' is non-empty. One of: json, jsonc, toml, yaml.
